answer.reason: The verses tell of Rameses as a city the Israelites built for Pharaoh and as the place they set out from at the Exodus.

clauses.english: was built by the Israelites as a treasure city for Pharaoh
clauses.quote: they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.

clauses.english: was where the Israelites set out from when they left Egypt
clauses.quote: they departed from Rameses in the first month

doubts: EXO 1:11 spells the name Raamses; taken as the same place as Rameses.
GEN 47:11 (land of Rameses) left out because the summary already covers it.
